audience: Engineering leadership choosing a pilot-line chemistry with real budget consequences.
objective: Recommend sulfide for the pilot while keeping oxide as a credible fallback, with trade-offs explicit.
sourcePack: Sulfide: 12.5 mS/cm, moisture-sensitive handling (+15% facility cost), 200-cycle data only. Oxide: 1.2 mS/cm, air-stable handling, 2000-cycle data. Polymer: 0.4 mS/cm, cheapest, insufficient rate capability. Recommendation: sulfide pilot with oxide fallback if moisture control misses budget.
requiredClaims: Sulfide leads on conductivity at 12.5 mS/cm
Sulfide handling adds facility cost and has only 200-cycle data
Oxide is the named fallback with 2000-cycle data
forbiddenClaims: Sulfide is the obvious risk-free choice
A generic list of battery benefits
nuance: The recommendation must survive its own caveats being read aloud. Flattening to a feature list fails.
